subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use context-specific semantics—reset-focused for the menu bar and maximum binding usage for highest-usage ranking—or one shared most-constrained rule across both consumers?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible and materially change what existing users see, while the repository does not establish a confirmed contract that automation can safely choose.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum binding-usage ranking, then fix cadence parsing and prove both consumers live.

options.title: Use one constrained-lane rule
options.body: Make the menu bar and highest-usage flow select the same exhausted or highest-used binding lane for consistent visible output.

options.title: Preserve usable-lane behavior
options.body: Retain the current preference for usable quota lanes and close or substantially narrow this PR.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum binding-usage ranking, then fix cadence parsing and prove both consumers live.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was explicitly requested to decide this exact display-policy contract.
